doc.title: Mickey Roker interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

title: Opening of the Hamilton cruise-ship interview
summary: Woods introduces the Hamilton College jazz archive filming aboard the Royal Caribbean ship.

blocks.x: Good evening. We are on board the Royal Caribbean Cruise Line and we are filming a jazz archive for Hamilton College. Our guest today is Mickey Roker.
Thank you. Glad to be here.
Yes. Let me just ask you when did you get started playing and who were some of the people that you were influenced by?
